blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Malacañang has accepted the resignation of Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) Secretary Henry Aguda, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla confirmed on Saturday, October 10. In a statement, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said at least three individuals are being considered to replace Aguda. They are David “Dave” Almirol Jr., […]...
